preconditions.description: The number of testcases t is between 1 and 100000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(a) <= 100000 for a in testcases)
preconditions.description: The length of each string a in testcases is between 1 and 100000 inclusive.
Each string a in testcases consists only of the characters 'A', 'N', 'O', and 'T'.
The sum of the lengths of all strings a in testcases does not exceed 100000.

postconditions.expression: all(len(b) == len(a) for a, b in zip(testcases, results))
postconditions.description: Each output string b has the same length as the corresponding input string a.

postconditions.expression: all(set(b) == set(a) for a, b in zip(testcases, results))
postconditions.description: Each output string b is a permutation of the corresponding input string a.

postconditions.expression: all(b in set(itertools.permutations(a)) for a, b in zip(testcases, results))
postconditions.description: Each output string b is a valid permutation of the corresponding input string a.
